method: Actual production reducer; all rooms/doors/hires and answers use commands; no balance, fee, wage, room-tier, training-tier or XP override.

assumptions.initialClinic: Synthetic Level 5 opening, zero XP, $30,000 before paid construction/hiring; existing early Level 4 specialty factory plus normal Reading/Training rooms and all five prestige rooms; all tiers/training 1, default salaries, no advertising.
assumptions.clinical: Full current eligible content, normal routine cadence restored once at opening, one chart action per active minute, 80% and 90% first-key accuracy; no employee discussion answers or emergency income.
assumptions.passive: Scored arrivals suppressed only in clearly labeled autonomous-income references; no scored income or XP.
assumptions.sensitivities: Half-gift withholds every second exogenous gift-only opportunity, preserving the 120-minute catalog and ordinary shopping. Slow-demand also toggles ordinary scheduled appointments off for alternating half-days; it does not change published fees or cadence.
assumptions.missedRound: Real upstream hallway sale makes the Executive Office inaccessible, retaining full support upkeep and $45 wage; missed-first-round rebuilds the hallway after day 1 (capital excluded from operating margin). Gift/Garden/Gym stay connected. Gift outage uses actual missing door and existing technical upkeep relief. The isolated reader-training sensitivity withholds unanswered staff conversations and requests once normal arrival makes the production training quote available. Its paid 60-minute session and travel interrupt warmup reading; the measured period includes genuinely earned tier 2, not a tier override. All normal and pacing runs retain ordinary staff discussions.
assumptions.clock: Active game hours and ten-hour operating days. Script execution speed and human reading time are not measured.
assumptions.ownership: No owner storage, external clinical sources, gameplay web/AI, Git, installs or launch switch.

auditInputProvenance.description: Only the isolated reader-training scheduler and audit orchestration/provenance changed. Completed non-training runs retain their actual prior source key. Reducer class, pacing function and every economic-loop statement outside the training scheduling block are byte-identical. Every balance, game-domain, clinical and fixture input remains hash-identical. Earlier production revisions and old training caches are rejected.
